title: 第1章 千仞雪穿越斗二，堕落者遍地
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

万年前，武魂城斗罗殿内——

“千仞雪拔出天使圣剑成功！天使神第七考完成！奖励魂力提升，天使神亲和度80%！”

雌雄难辨的神音落下，千仞雪终于艰难完成了天使神第七考。

“爷爷我做到了！”

手持天使圣剑，千仞雪很高兴，于是她从天使神殿中走出想要去往现世跟自己的爷爷一同分享这份喜悦。

所以她如同往常一般，走向天使神殿的出口，边走还边打量着手中新获得的神器——天使圣剑。

以至于她此时并没有发现，出了天使圣殿后，她的落地点并不是她所熟悉的斗罗殿、武魂城。

而是万年后的明斗山脉。

“嗯？这里是哪里？我斗罗殿呢？这环境也不是武魂城附近。难道这是天使神的旨意，我即将进行天使神八考了吗？”

等到千仞雪察觉到不对时，立马握紧手中的天使圣剑警戒四周。

随即想到可能是天使神手笔时，她下意识去感应额头的天使神印记。

结果一点动静都没有，那感觉就好像天使神的一切都与她断了联系，根本感应不到天使神神力了。

“奇怪，为何会是这样？我居然感觉不到一点天使神的神威了？那我为何会在这里？”

千仞雪很是疑惑，所以为了搞清楚，她提起天使圣剑想要搞清楚这里到底是什么地方。

结果刚走几步，她便神色一凛。

“这波动，是堕落者！数量还不少！可怎么可能？在我武魂殿的治下，居然还有如此多的堕落者？天使军团最近懈怠了吗？”

千仞雪脸上怒气一闪，随后身后六翼出现，下一秒千仞雪便提起天使圣剑冲了出去。

径直飞向了堕落者所在处。

“你们这些贱民能成为我血魔大人的血食是你们几世修来的福分！呸，这人类血液果然不如魂师的血好喝，等老子伤势恢复了一定要抓几个魂师换换口味！”

自称血魔的邪魂师大言不惭后还略显嫌弃的呸了口，可手下的动作丝毫不见他收敛，反而更加残忍。

眼见最后的幸存者将要死在他与他的同伴手下时，突然天际降下一道耀眼的金光。

“嘭！”

“啊——”

天使圣剑狠狠刺穿邪魂师血魔，使得对方只来得及发出一声惨叫，就在天使圣剑的神力下魂飞魄散，什么都没留下了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Thousands of years ago, in the Douluo Hall of Wuhun City——

"Qian Renxue successfully pulled out the Holy Angel Sword! The seventh test of the Angel God is completed! The reward is an increase in soul power, and the affinity of the Angel God is 80%!"

The indistinguishable divine voice fell, and Qian Renxue finally completed the seventh test of the Angel God with difficulty.

"Grandpa, I did it!"

Holding the Angel Holy Sword, Qian Renxue was very happy, so she walked out of the Angel Temple and wanted to go to the living world to share this joy with her grandfather.

So she walked towards the exit of the Angel Temple as usual, looking at the newly acquired artifact in her hand - the Holy Angel Sword.

So much so that she didn't realize at this time that after leaving the Angel Temple, her landing place was not the Douluo Temple or Wuhun City that she was familiar with.

But the Mingdou Mountains ten thousand years later.

"Huh? Where is this place? Where is my Douluo Palace? This environment is not near Wuhun City. Is this the will of the Angel God? Am I about to take the Eight Angel God Exams?"

When Qian Renxue realized something was wrong, she immediately clenched the angel holy sword in her hand to guard the surroundings.

Then she thought that it might be the handiwork of the angel god, and she subconsciously sensed the mark of the angel god on her forehead.

As a result, there was no movement at all. It felt as if everything about the Angel God had been cut off from her, and she could no longer sense the Angel God's power.

"Strange, why is this like this? I can't feel the power of the angel god at all? Then why am I here?"

Qian Renxue was very confused, so in order to find out, she mentioned the Angel Holy Sword to find out what this place was.

As a result, after taking a few steps, she suddenly looked stern.

"This fluctuation is the Fallen! There are quite a few! But how is it possible? Under the rule of my Spirit Hall, there are actually so many Fallen? Have the Angel Legion been slacking off recently?"

Qian Renxue's face flashed with anger, and then Six Wings appeared behind her. In the next second, Qian Renxue picked up the Angel Holy Sword and rushed out.

It flew straight to where the Fallen was.

"You untouchables can become the blood food of my Lord Blood Demon. It is a blessing that you have cultivated for several lifetimes! Bah, this human blood is not as delicious as the blood of a soul master. When I recover from my injury, I must capture a few soul masters for a change!"

The evil soul master who called himself the Blood Demon uttered his words in disgust, but his actions did not show any sign of restraint, and instead became more cruel.

When he saw that the last survivor was about to die at the hands of him and his companions, a dazzling golden light suddenly fell from the sky.

"Bang!"

"Ah——"

The angel's holy sword pierced the evil soul master Blood Demon fiercely, so that the opponent only had time to let out a scream, and then his soul flew away under the power of the angel's holy sword, leaving nothing behind.
